before.en: A 58-year-old woman with stage IIIB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is on day 10 of cycle 2 R-CHOP and is in the expected count nadir window. She was admitted two days ago for poor oral intake and dehydration. A triple-lumen PICC is patent. Standing orders require blood cultures and immediate oncology notification for a single oral temperature ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) or temperature ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) sustained over one hour.
before.zh: 一名 58 岁女性，患 IIIB 期弥漫大 B 细胞淋巴瘤，正在第 2 个 R-CHOP 周期第 10 天，处于预期血细胞计数低谷期。她两天前因进食差和脱水入院。三腔 PICC 通畅。常规医嘱要求：单次口温 ≥ 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) 或体温 ≥ 100.4 °F (38.0 °C) 持续 1 小时时，采集血培养并立即通知肿瘤科。
